en.hero_sub: Point the launcher at the dumps of your own DLC: Cole's Legacy and the vests unlock in the game.
hero_pts: Cole's Legacy missions on the map
5 vests: JOS, Penny Arcade, EXIST, iam8bit, Cole's
cards: A switch in the launcher and the menu.
FSR 4, XeSS and DLSS get the texture mip bias.
One file per game, popup test button.
Themes, every page, Steam Deck goal.
also_pts: Sharpening 0-100 %, mouse side buttons, faster pad camera
Game patches: no Pro mode, one resolution / FOV patch at a time
next_pts: Fix for the NVIDIA crash in the opening village
More of the game in the shader seed
